context: Evaluates correct implementation of the getConfig() singleton configuration service. Tests that the config is fetched only once via lazy loading, subsequent calls return the same cached promise, non-OK HTTP responses throw errors, and the cache is cleared on error to permit retries.

checklist.name: Module-level cache variable
checklist.description: A module-level variable (e.g., configPromise) is used to cache the promise, initialized to null.

checklist.name: Fetch on first call only
checklist.description: fetch('/exiftool_config.json') is called only when the cache variable is null/falsy, not on every invocation.

checklist.name: Response JSON parsed
checklist.description: The fetch response is checked for response.ok, then response.json() is called to parse the configuration.

checklist.name: Same promise returned
checklist.description: Subsequent calls to getConfig() return the exact same promise object that was created on the first call.

checklist.name: Cache cleared on error
checklist.description: In the catch handler, the cache variable is set back to null to allow the next call to trigger a fresh fetch.

checklist.name: Error re-thrown
checklist.description: After clearing the cache, the error is re-thrown so callers can handle it appropriately.
